definitions.explanation: The rear surface of the human body from the shoulders to the waist. Used for physical descriptions and back-related expressions.

examples.japanese: {背中|せなか}が{痒|かゆ}いです。
{背中|せなか}を{向|む}けないでください。
examples.english: Please don't turn your back to me.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{背中|せなか}を{押|お}しました。
examples.english: I pushed the child's back (gave them a push/encouragement).
examples.notes: Can mean literal pushing or figurative encouragement

examples.japanese: {背中|せなか}が{痛|いた}いです。
{背中|せなか}に{何|なに}か{付|つ}いていますよ。

notes:
{背中|せなか} refers specifically to the back of the human body, from shoulders to waist. It differs from {背|せ} which can mean height or the back more generally.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {背中|せなか}が{痛|いた}い: my back hurts
- {背中|せなか}を{向|む}ける: to turn one's back (on someone)
- {背中|せなか}を{押|お}す: to push someone's back; to encourage someone
- {背中|せなか}を{見|み}せる: to show one's back; to set an example

IDIOMATIC USES:
{背中|せなか}を{押|お}す is often used figuratively to mean "to give someone encouragement" or "to give someone the push they need."

RELATED BODY PARTS:
- {腰|こし}: lower back, waist
- {肩|かた}: shoulder
- {背骨|せぼね}: spine
